scripts.local-api:dev: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; exec env DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://astrology:astrology@127.0.0.1:5432/astrology} ASTRO_DEMO_AUTH=${ASTRO_DEMO_AUTH:-0} HOST=${HOST:-0.0.0.0} PORT=${PORT:-4020} ASTRO_PA_ROOT=${ASTRO_PA_ROOT:-./engine} DATA_DIR=${DATA_DIR:-./.local-data} PYTHON=${PYTHON:-../.venv/bin/python} tsx api/server.ts'
scripts.test: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; exec env DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://astrology:astrology@127.0.0.1:5432/astrology_test} ASTRO_DEMO_AUTH=1 PYTHON=${PYTHON:-../.venv/bin/python} tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts'
